dct_description_sm: Abstract: This datalayer contains city ward boundaries linked to Census demographics for Chennai, India, 2001. Includes city ward socio-demographic and economic Census attribute data such as total population, population by sex, rural/urban populations, household, literacy, and employment statistics. This layer is part of the Wards of Indian Cities dataset series which includes socio-demographic and economic Census data for 2001 for selected Indian cities at the City Ward level.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
